title: Coeliac Disease: Lifelong Dietary Management and Follow-Up

evidenceAudit.scope: Adult or child with diagnosed coeliac disease: annual review, supplements, gluten-free oats, non-responsive and refractory disease, using NICE NG20.
findings: Every dose, threshold and timing was checked against the cited source section on 2026-10-18.
Normal values are typical adult reference ranges; laboratories differ.
unverifiedSections: NICE NG20 as extracted gives no supplement doses and no drug treatments.
Vaccination and bone density testing recommendations were not captured.
Source pages were read through automated page extraction rather than page-by-page in the original documents, so each figure should be spot-checked against the source during clinical review.

pathophysiology.summary: Serology alone must not be used to decide whether gluten has been excluded from the diet. An annual review covers weight, height, symptoms, diet adherence and the need for dietetic advice. Persistent symptoms prompt review of the diagnosis, specialist dietitian input on gluten exposure and a search for coexisting conditions.

clinicalManagement.title: Annual review
actions: Review weight, height, symptoms, diet adherence and dietetic needs; refer to the GP or consultant for concerns.

clinicalManagement.title: Supplements
actions: Consider calcium or vitamin D; advise consulting the healthcare team before over-the-counter supplements.

clinicalManagement.title: Oats
actions: Gluten-free oats may be included with advice based on response.

clinicalManagement.title: Persistent symptoms
actions: Review diagnosis, consult a specialist dietitian and investigate coexisting conditions.

medicationPlan.note: NICE NG20 does not mention drug treatment for coeliac disease. Calcium or vitamin D supplements are advised only if dietary intake is insufficient; no dose is given.

diagnosticCriteria.threshold: Offer yearly to everyone with coeliac disease.
